    Closure properties of C_J and smallness of C(D) (Corollary 2.4) #

    C_J is closed under isomorphisms, finite direct sums and extensions: the middle term of a realization has ρ-image an extension of good representations, hence good. C(D) is essentially small: every object is isomorphic to one indexed by some Fin n.
